item.title: Lunars Confirmed For Steam Early Access Launch in Mid-January
item.description: The chaotic zodiac party game Lunars has been given an Early Access launch date, as we'll see it arrive for PC via Steam in mid-January

item.title: Preserve Releases new Massive Ice Age Expansion
item.description: Can you adapt your ecosystem to the cold? Preserve has a new massive expansion that brings the Ice Age to your ever-changing biomes

item.title: Send Help: 2 New High-Quality Images From Sam Raimi's New Film
item.description: Two new high-quality images for Sam Raimi's latest film, Send Help, have been released. The film will be released on January 30th.

item.title: Bladesong Announced For Late January Early Access Launch
item.description: Dubbed the ultimate swordmaking game, Bladesong has been given an Early Access launch date set for late January on Steam

item.title: Civilization VII Offers Tides of Power Free For Limited Time
item.description: Civilization VII is offering up the Tides of Power Collection for free for a limited time, as you have about a week left to claim it

item.title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon Announced
item.description: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon was announced this month, possibly coming out sometime in 2026... we think...

item.title: MMORPG Sequel Fallen Sword II Announced For 2026
item.description: Fallen Sword II, the sequel to the long-running MMORPG, has been announced with a plan to be released sometime in the Summer of 2026

item.title: Games Done Quick's Frost Fatales Will Return in March 2026
item.description: Games Done Quick has revealed the schedule for their annual Frost Fatales event will happen totally online once again in March 2026
